summary: Atheos is a web-based integrated development environment framework designed as a lightweight successor to Codiad. It allows you to write and edit code directly through a browser interface with minimal server resource requirements. The application is built using PHP and distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you need a lightweight, browser-accessible code editor that can run on low-powered hardware or minimal infrastructure.
watchOut: The project exhibits low maintenance activity and an at-risk health score, meaning you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack timely security updates. It also overlaps heavily with more mature and widely adopted web-based development environments.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running the PHP application via Docker, requiring persistent storage volumes for your source code files. You will also need to configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for secure browser access.
